suite: annotate top bar + entry context (auto-filter, see-through)
expect_red: unticking Parts returns the lists to manual at once

mutations.contract: Unticking an auto-filter switch returns that control to manual AT ONCE -- a switch whose effect only shows up on the next launch is a switch nobody can tell is working.
mutations.note: The mutation drops only the immediate lift and keeps the stored setting, which is the plausible half-implementation: the box stays unticked, it survives a reload, and the next arrival really does skip the step -- so every check except the one about NOW stays green. It took a code change to make this witnessable: the lift and the re-apply were an if/else, so dropping the lift fell through to the replay, whose own topology re-select clears the scope anyway -- the mutation lifted the filter by a second route and the tier stayed green. Two independent statements now.
